release_notes: 🔊 Volume System (Android & Windows): Upgraded to 5% step increments (0% to 200%) for precise control
🎚️ Volume Controls (Android & Windows): Added support for mouse wheel, keyboard arrows, and UI slider improvements
📊 Volume OSD (Android & Windows): Improved accuracy and visual feedback during volume changes
🎬 Playlist (Android & Windows): Enhanced current item highlighting with play icon and visual emphasis
💾 Playlist (Android & Windows): Added auto-save and restore of last played playlist on startup
📁 Recent Media (Android & Windows): Introduced tracking of last 10 played media files
ℹ️ Media Info (Android & Windows): Added properties dialog with file name, duration, size, and resolution
✨ UI Improvements (Android & Windows): Added smooth PiP fade animation (150ms) and improved empty states
⌨️ Shortcuts (Windows & Android): Added global keyboard shortcuts for playback, volume, fullscreen, and file operations
⚙️ Settings (Android & Windows): Added Updates section with version info and manual update checking
🚨 Error Handling (Android & Windows): Improved user-friendly error messages for better clarity
🧾 About (Android & Windows): Added application information dialog with version and platform details
🧠 Stability (Android & Windows): Improved startup flow and update engine reliability
⚡ Performance (Android & Windows): General optimizations and bug fixes
